fields.System.Title: CNT-101 — Create a count plan
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to define what should be counted and how often, so
that counting effort is planned rather than reactive.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a scope — zone, location type, or product class — then a count plan can be
  • created with a frequency.
  • - Given a plan, then it records how many locations per day it expects to generate.
  • - Given overlapping plans, then a location is not scheduled twice on the same day.
  • - Given a plan, then it can be paused without being deleted.
